# Burner funding (your treasury)

Guard does not sponsor gas, watch balances, or call faucets.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Chain | arb-sepolia / op-sepolia / base-sepolia |
| Burner address (not the key) | |
| Who tops it up | |
| Minimum balance that pages someone | |
| What the agent does when balance is below the next cap | stop / page / |

Keys stay in the signer. A low balance is a stuck agent, not a Guard failure. The offline demo does not need this row. Live forwards do.
